title: Invert Train Carriage Sequence
description: You are managing a freight train where each carriage is linked to the next one in a linear sequence of goods. Due to a track reconfiguration, you need to completely reverse the direction of the train's carriages so that the last carriage becomes the first, the second-to-last becomes the second, and so on. Given the head of a singly linked list representing the train carriages, return the head of the reversed train.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is the range [0, 5000].
input_format: The head of a singly linked list.
output_format: The head of the reversed singly linked list.

examples.explanation: The train sequence is reversed from front to back.
A train with two carriages is inverted.
